summary: Shell plc filed a Form 6-K reporting routine PDMR share transactions. Peter Costello, President, Upstream, disposed of 31,786 ordinary shares at GBP 33.41 and 3,214 ordinary shares at EUR 39.115 on August 28, 2026, for total proceeds of approximately GBP 1,061,970 and EUR 125,716. These are ordinary share sales by a managerial insider, not a special situation. The filing also incorporates by reference existing registration statements. No corporate action, acquisition, divestiture, tender, or strategic event is involved. This is a routine disclosure of insider transactions under UK/EU market abuse rules, with no impact on shareholders or risk-arb considerations.
